header.title: Semiconductor margin expansion and one-off gains temporarily inflate earnings and will fade

s01_bottom_line.text: Memory producers are generating gross margins of roughly 80%, more than double historical average, from tight supply; and large tech recorded ~$150bn of unrealized private-investment gains in Q2 2026 (12% of S&P 500 EPS). ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩

Margin expansion has driven a large share of recent semiconductor earnings growth, but that boost should fade; unrealized investment gains will contribute much less in 2027. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩

A meaningful chunk of recent semiconductor and tech earnings reflects transient margin expansion and non-operating gains; as these fade, reported earnings growth could disappoint even if volumes hold.
